Build the registered universe of organizations

Source: R/source-registered.R
npc_build_registered.Rd

Builds one row per organization and tax year for every organization on the IRS registry, filers and non-filers alike, and classifies each organization-year by what it filed. The result is written to dir/registered-<filer_source>/orgs/ as a Parquet dataset partitioned by YEAR and read with npc_get_orgs(universe = "registered") or "grassroots", which call this function for missing years.

Usage

npc_build_registered(
  years,
  filer_source = c("nccs", "archive"),
  dir = npc_cache_dir(),
  filer_dir = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

years

Tax years, 2010 onward, within the filer panel's coverage.

filer_source

Where the 990 / 990-EZ filers come from: "nccs" (a live build, see npc_build_nccs()) or "archive" (the SOI panel archive).

dir

Cache directory; see npc_cache_dir(). Downloads and the registered dataset go here.

filer_dir

Directory of the filer panel: the archive directory for filer_source = "archive" (default npc_archive_dir()), or a live build (default dir).

refresh

Download the BMF, revocation and e-postcard files again.

Value

The output directory, invisibly. It holds the Parquet dataset, year-counts.csv (organizations per year by filer type) and manifest.csv.

Who is registered in year t

The unified BMF records the first and last monthly BMF vintage in which each EIN appeared. An organization is registered from its ruling year (or its first BMF vintage, if earlier or the ruling year is unknown) through the year of its last vintage. Organizations still in the latest vintage stay registered. Years between an automatic revocation and a reinstatement are dropped, and a revocation ends the span if it comes before the organization left the BMF. NCCS kept only three BMF vintages between August 2016 and January 2022, so exits in those years without a revocation date are dated to the last vintage seen.

Any organization in the filer panel for year t is registered in t, even if its BMF span says otherwise.

Filer types

990, 990EZ

In the filer panel for t (exact tax year).

990PF

A private foundation on the BMF (PF filing requirement code 1, or foundation code 2-4). Foundations file the 990-PF, which the filer panels do not cover, so they have no financial data here.

990N

Not a filer or foundation, and either filed a 990-N postcard for t or has a BMF filing requirement code of 2 (gross receipts normally under the 990-N threshold). The postcard file holds only each organization's latest filing, so earlier years rely on the BMF code.

NONFILER

Everyone else: churches not required to file (CHURCH = TRUE, filing requirement code 6), dormant organizations not yet revoked, and organizations missing from the filer panel.

Imputed gap-year rows of the archive panel do not count as filings; they are classified like other non-filers and keep IMPUTED = TRUE.

Location, subsector, subsection and ruling year come from the BMF for every row (from the filer panel only when the BMF has no record), so a filer's county here can differ from its county in the archive.

See also

npc_get_orgs(), npc_registry_spans()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
npc_build_registered( 2018:2020 )
g <- npc_get_orgs( 2019, universe = "grassroots", source = "nccs" )
table( g$FILER_TYPE )
} # }
